ranked.summary: Benchmarks now quantify how database curation, sequencing depth, and method consensus constrain accuracy in microbial profiling.

ranked.summary: Deep models are being applied to histology, CODEX and spatial transcriptomics where annotations are scarce and batch effects persist.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark and extend foundation models for DNA, RNA and protein sequence tasks, from mRNA design to base-editing prediction.

ranked.summary: Network-based models are being used to infer regulatory structure and integrate incomplete or heterogeneous multi-omics and perturbation data.

ranked.summary: Long-read and population-scale sequencing now resolve methylation and genome variation across Arabidopsis, human and mitochondrial genomes.

ranked.summary: Interpretable architectures now encode interaction graphs, phylogeny, and ORFs directly, making genomic predictions inspectable.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one published pipeline deliver reproducible, browser-accessible tools for variant, structural, genomic, and microbiome data.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks infer protein function and drug, microbe and disease associations
ranked.summary: Graph encoders fused with protein language model embeddings now target drug-target, microbe-disease, and GO term prediction.

ranked.summary: Recent MD studies resolve how single sequence changes and binding partners reshape allosteric pathways in RNA recognition and transcription.

ranked.summary: Spatial and flow cytometry snapshots now support trajectory inference from static measurements, alongside optimal transport and surrogate modeling.

ranked.summary: Population-scale genomics now resolves how bacterial mobile elements, prophages and defense systems exchange and coevolve across large genome collections.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study benchmark Nanopore m6A detection, nascent RNA simulation, and rRNA depletion probe design for RNA sequencing.

ranked.headline: Simulations tie resistance, transport, and resource supply to microbial outcomes
ranked.summary: Mechanistic models now treat resistance development, time-varying transport, and resource structure as controllable simulation variables.

ranked.headline: Reference-free and ensemble-level evaluation of biomolecular structure models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published tools address construction, validation, and preparation of biomolecular models against physical and experimental references.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair diffusion connectivity and surface geometry with deep registration and tau PET modeling to make neuroimaging analyses structure-aware.

ranked.headline: Feedback and criticality structure robust control from cells to gene networks
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and Boolean modeling studies converge on how feedback and bifurcation structure buffer biological systems against perturbation.

ranked.summary: Open, reproducible software packages now cover genomic tokenization for ML, proteomics QC reporting and scRNA-seq web analysis.

ranked.headline: Causal network, metabolic, and genetic views of disease-linked brain architecture
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published GWAS add causal, cell-subtype, and genetic resolution to brain architecture in disease.

ranked.headline: Connectivity and local feedback rules shape tuning and bursting in network models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a publication offer analytic and numerical frameworks for inferring tuning structure and network dynamics in circuits.

ranked.headline: Latent generative and representation models for single-cell and chromatin data
ranked.summary: Scaling generative and integrative models to single-cell expression, chromatin, and spatial data demands robust handling of imbalance and batch structure.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level assemblies for annelid, cricket, and tunicate genomic resources
ranked.summary: New chromosome-scale assemblies for Capitella teleta and Gryllus bimaculatus extend reference genomes with annotation and public resources.

ranked.summary: Coupled MD, adaptive sampling, unsupervised learning, and Markov state modeling now yield mechanistic kinetics for signaling proteins.

ranked.summary: Deep metabarcoding and ultra-short damaged ancient viral reads demand tools that filter artefacts and tolerate degradation.

ranked.summary: Recent preprints release open-source web tools and Python packages for analyzing lipidomics, cytokine array, and GNPS metabolomics data.
